cohort: 10 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) treated at Liaquat University Hospital, Sindh, Pakistan from January 2010 to December 2015.
finding: Sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) requires surgical excision by a team of experts.
mod_finding: Four patients were delivered by normal vaginal delivery and six by cesarean section.
gest_age: Nine full-term and one pre-term infant, ranging from 20 hours to 8 months of age
